title: Special Topics in Intermediate Theatre and Performance; Mask, Movement, and the Actor
description:
Pre-reqs: THET222 or THET120; or permission of instructor Students must pay a $25 lab fee

Through physical conditioning, improvisation, and ensemble movement explorations, students will develop the physical strength, creative flexibility, fearlessness, and dynamic spatial awareness with a variety of mask styles to inform their skills in performance when taking the masks off.
